subject.title: fix(providers): preserve WhatsApp and Zalo delivery

question: May raw recorder JSONL add documented versioned atomic batch records while supported Crabline reader APIs continue flattening them into individual events?
rationale: The implementation preserves Crabline API consumers, but code and tests cannot establish whether direct raw-file readers are covered by a permanent one-event-per-line compatibility promise.

options.title: Accept Versioned Batches
options.body: Treat Crabline recorder APIs as the supported reading contract and allow the documented atomic batch record in raw JSONL.

options.title: Preserve One-Event Lines
options.body: Require a different atomic publication design that retains one event object on every raw JSONL line.

recommendation.title: Accept Versioned Batches
recommendation.body: Treat Crabline recorder APIs as the supported reading contract and allow the documented atomic batch record in raw JSONL.

likelyOwner.reason: Their prior merged work most directly owns recorder compatibility and both affected provider lifecycles.
